LanguageData.USAC_Gun_ACSW.label: advanced support weapon
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_ACSW.description: The Project ACSW M307 "Terminator", a lightweight automatic grenade launcher that walks fragmentation grenades across infantry formations. An exoskeleton is required to carry both the weapon and its ammunition.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_ACSW.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_ACSW.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_BattleRifle.label: advanced battle rifle
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_BattleRifle.description: The M29 "SABR", an infantry weapon platform combining an automatic rifle with a grenade launcher, capable of direct suppression and indirect support alike. It is heavy, but remarkably accurate - an ideal weapon for a small unit's designated gunner.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_OSW.label: objective sniper weapon
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_OSW.description: The Project OSW M109 "Payload", a sniper grenade launcher carried by exoskeleton infantry. Its shaped-charge grenades are placed precisely enough to strip a target's surface armor and external sensors.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_OSW.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_OSW.tools.barrel.label: barrel
